updated: 30 October 2026 · campaign review 3 / scene pass 3 underway
verdict: Reference benchmark not passed · substantial rebuild in progress

pieces.name: The 1,000-floor campaign
pieces.evidence: Deterministic finite campaign, ten districts, timed hazards and saved checkpoints implemented. Focused core/server checks pass. The latest recovery-state edge case is corrected and awaiting independent verification.

pieces.name: Character & living tower
pieces.evidence: The first independent visual comparison preferred ASTRO BOT. A new architectural, material, character and camera pass addresses the largest observed gaps.

pieces.name: The spectator experience
pieces.evidence: Desktop/mobile controls, pause, speed, camera, opt-in audio and saved progress implemented. Mobile/settings and progress-page browser checks pass; transport and restore checks hit rendering delays and remain unresolved.

iterations.label: Baseline · d1678cd
iterations.title: From a catalogue entry to a real expedition
iterations.summary: The existing repository named AI vs 1,000 Floors and specified a finite campaign with checkpoints, but had no playable Game 4 runtime. This is the honest starting point.
iterations.verdict: No visual benchmark result is claimed. First runtime and captures are being prepared.

iterations.label: Iteration 1 · actual gameplay
iterations.title: A working climb, an honest first comparison
iterations.summary: The first real 3D campaign introduced an explorer, companion, seeded platforms, timed hazards and checkpoint progress. The independent critic inspected actual frames and moving traversal beside official ASTRO BOT clips.
iterations.verdict: Reference preferred. Main gaps: floating primitive scenery, weak material distinction, limited articulation, hazard clarity and portrait framing.

iterations.label: Iteration 2 · actual gameplay
iterations.title: Stronger platform dressing and a clearer portrait HUD
iterations.summary: Added terracotta edging, vegetation, movement interpolation and a low exit beacon; compressed the mobile HUD. Campaign reviews corrected live hazard contact and accepted-save inconsistencies.
iterations.verdict: Benchmark remains not passed. The scene still needs authored depth, stronger character animation, safe camera framing and fewer draw calls.

iterations.label: Iteration 3 · work in progress
iterations.title: Architecture, character and performance
iterations.summary: Builders are replacing the flat surrounding disk with a hollow citadel, textured surfaces and district landmarks. A separate character/renderer builder is adding limb articulation, camera fitting and static geometry batching.
iterations.verdict: No new visual verdict until the integrated running build is captured and independently reviewed.

references.name: ASTRO BOT
references.role: Primary: fully realized characters, animation, environments, camera clarity and feedback. Actual Spring-Loaded Run and Rising Heat gameplay clips are the comparison sources.

references.name: Luigi’s Mansion 3
references.role: Distinct floor identities through architecture, dressing, staging and light.

references.name: Returnal · Tower of Sisyphus
references.role: Tower presentation, spatial depth and readable action.

gaps: The inspected visual result still loses to the fixed ASTRO BOT gameplay references.
The latest recovery-state fix needs independent confirmation; focused regression tests pass.
Transport and reload browser checks must pass after rendering overhead is reduced; an advancing HUD is not sufficient evidence.
Representative later districts, moving character poses and bounded resource behaviour need current-build inspection.
The campaign currently follows one generated route per floor; alternative route decisions are not implemented.
